summary: The CEO of Nvidia has said there is no need to introduce regulations in the AI sector, following widespread concerns over safety.  Speaking at a Salesforce event on Tuesday, Jensen Huang said no new laws or regulations were needed for AI safety, adding that companies should pace themselves until they are certain they're releasing something the market would appreciate.  Mr Huang recently organised an open letter to warn policymakers against placing heavy restrictions on open-weight AI models.
